findings.text: the fragment measures spend against an "authorised USD 2.25 total ceiling" that no brief the node carries states (brief.md and prompt.txt both read "Cap the spend at USD 2"); the raise lives only in the run-directory resume-1-advice.txt, so a reader of the committed fragment alone reads the USD 2.048175 spend as exceeding its own cap.

the cause is evidenced through run-directory logs named in the fragment (live-domain-census.log, classification-cohorts.log, prompt-vocabulary.log) but none is committed; only results.json is in-repo, so the fragment's cause cannot be re-derived from the repository, the driver reproducing the accuracies only.

item_verdicts.call_sites: none: the node changes no runtime code and its only executable artefact is a standalone evidence driver that no production module imports.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 5af30bd9452b0a5529ac69c05010cd710083a2a2; eight additive commits (9455 insertions, 0 deletions) create the driver, the results JSON and the fragment under docs/evidence/fragments/sn-catalog-grouping/, importing pick_primary_domain, gather_classification_context and classify_tier1_llm from their owners, and touch nothing under imas_codex/.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when asks for the fragment naming the cause, a driver writing results.json with three accuracies and the spend, two logged runs, a before/after no-property-changed count, and the tests/graph/test_dd_domain_classifier.py gate (plus test_cypher_property_check.py for any Cypher); the manifest records base 114 passed EXIT=0 and head 118 passed EXIT=0, and the committed results.json holds 170 rows, 856 paths, USD 2.048175 and an identical before/after digest.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to diagnose why the DD per-path physics_domain echoes its IDS and to measure stored/fresh/derived domain accuracy against the labelled names; scg-dd-domain-diagnosis.html:14-17 names the cause (build_dd.py:3495 and :3583 overwrite the path domain, dd_domain_classifier.py:1022 skips it) and :60-61 report all three accuracies for both cohorts.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at the run directory; status complete; eight commits; changed_paths names the three fragment files; test_logs names base-gate.log and final-head-gate.log, both present; baseline_suite and after_suite are empty (unarmed) but the two gate logs are readable and give the delta.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the brief's Write scope lists scg-dd-domain-diagnosis-run.py, scg-dd-domain-diagnosis-results.json and scg-dd-domain-diagnosis.html; git diff --stat 5af30bd9..5b31377c is exactly those three files, all inside the grant.

justifications.durability: scg-dd-domain-diagnosis-run.py:44 (positive control), :121 (spend reserve) and :230 (before != after read-only guard) are live guards that raise on regression, but no committed test fails if the driver regresses and no red-log negative control demonstrates a guard firing.
justifications.evidence: base-gate.log (114 passed EXIT=0) and final-head-gate.log (118 passed EXIT=0) record the named gate and results.json plus replay-comparison.log record the accuracies, rows, spend and equal before/after digest, but the named gate exercises the untouched classifier, not the diagnosis, so it is a regression baseline rather than a measure of the accuracy figures.
justifications.fit: scg-dd-domain-diagnosis.html is a well-formed section fragment and scg-dd-domain-diagnoses-run.py:1 follows the module-docstring, argparse and print-receipt idiom of its peer fragment scripts, with no plan or ticket label in any content symbol.
justifications.goal_fidelity: scg-dd-domain-diagnosis.html:14-17 pins the cause to build_dd.py:3495 and :3583 with dd_domain_classifier.py:1022 (all three confirmed present and matching the text) and :60-61 report stored/fresh/derived accuracies identical to results.json.
justifications.reuse: scg-dd-domain-diagnosis-run.py:18-20 imports pick_primary_domain, gather_classification_context and classify_tier1_llm from their owners, and the local _read_sources/_snapshot/_score helpers have no repository owner (a search over imas_codex for a label-versus-prediction confusion scorer and a graph-property digest found only unrelated benchmark and prompt-cache utilities).
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only 5af30bd9..5b31377c lists exactly the three granted fragment paths and no file under imas_codex/ is modified.
